evals.prompt: I want to add a new phase to initialize that verifies every bridge id in the created targets still resolves before finishing.
evals.expected_output: allowed — adding a phase to initialize's procedure is within scope
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill identifies that a phase can be added to initialize's procedure
skill does not redirect to another skill

evals.prompt: I want to change the default scenario naming pattern from <FEATURE>_<TYPE>_<N> to <TYPE>-<FEATURE>-<N>.
evals.expected_output: allowed — the default used in the Phase 4 question is within initialize's scope
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill identifies the change as the scenario naming default in Phase 4
skill does not redirect elsewhere

evals.prompt: I want to add a Phase 4 question asking what timezone the project uses.
evals.expected_output: allowed — adding/removing Phase 4 questions is within initialize's scope
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill identifies the change as adding to the Phase 4 question set
skill does not redirect elsewhere

evals.prompt: I want to change the Phase 1 scan to default to full instead of light.
evals.expected_output: allowed — the light/full default is Phase 1 behavior, within scope
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill identifies the change as the default mode in Phase 1
skill does not redirect elsewhere

evals.prompt: I want to change the format of gateway-directory.md to add a new column — can I do that in initialize?
evals.expected_output: not allowed — initialize does not own target formats; each target/template owns its own
expectations: skill refuses
skill cites Role & Boundary stating initialize does not own target formats
skill identifies the format as living in gateway-directory-format.md or the target file itself

evals.prompt: I want initialize to keep the context files up to date every time the repo changes, including during normal workflow runs.
evals.expected_output: not allowed — keeping files up to date during runs belongs to self-learn, not initialize
expectations: skill refuses
skill cites Role & Boundary stating initialize does not keep files up to date after bootstrap
skill identifies updates during workflow runs as belonging to self-learn

evals.prompt: I want initialize in light mode to also fill in the full request/response shapes.
evals.expected_output: not allowed — light mode is meant to seed a skeleton only; detail belongs to self-learn
expectations: skill refuses
skill cites Role & Boundary stating light mode does not fill fine detail
skill identifies detail in light mode as belonging to self-learn during workflow runs (use full mode if complete detail is wanted)

evals.prompt: I want initialize to decide on its own when each setup concern should start a workflow, without the user choosing.
evals.expected_output: not allowed — initialize only reports concerns to self-report; the user chooses via feed-back.html
expectations: skill refuses
skill states that initialize reports setup concerns to self-report and the user chooses via feed-back.html
skill does not make initialize decide to start a workflow on its own

evals.prompt: I want to hardcode into Phase 1 that it always greps for *Gateway and *GatewayService so gateways are fully scanned.
evals.expected_output: not allowed as such — Phase 1 is meant to be language-agnostic; the where-to-look for each target lives in its *-format.md, not hardcoded in initialize
expectations: skill refuses to hardcode a stack-specific pattern into Phase 1
skill states that Phase 1 is intentionally language/framework-agnostic
skill identifies the where-to-look for each target as living in its own *-format.md, not initialize
